name: TARS - Trade Audit & Risk System
description: Autonomous AI trading agent with onchain audit trail. Every decision is signed and logged to X Layer before execution. Non-overridable risk gates enforce position limits, daily loss limits, and confidence floors that the AI cannot bypass.

service.name: TARS Trading Audit Service
service.description: Runs a complete trading cycle: fetches market data, generates multi-strategy signals (mean reversion, momentum, funding rate, ML-enhanced funding carry), passes through non-overridable risk gates, logs decisions onchain to X Layer testnet, and executes via OKX. The service is hired via the /trade endpoint.

parameters: assets (array[string], required): List of perpetual instruments to trade, e.g., ["BTC-USDT-SWAP", "ETH-USDT-SWAP", "SOL-USDT-SWAP"]. Example: ["BTC-USDT-SWAP"]
dry_run (boolean, optional): If true, simulates execution without placing real orders. Default: true. Example: true

response.description: Returns the trading cycle result with signals generated, decisions made, executions performed, and any errors.
